_what: How a maker of a paid Marketplace tool sets up payouts and reads what they are owed (src/maker-payouts.mjs). Earnings are the tool_sales rows the shared pool already keeps (one per completed paid run, marked when the charge is given back). `operations` names the payment provider's operation rows (parts/stripe-payment-provider/data/stripe-operation-map.json) used to open a payee account, read it, make its one-time setup page and its dashboard sign-in; the provider collects the maker's identity and bank on its own page. `payee_settings` is what a new payee account is opened with, `country` the country it is opened in when the maker names none. `ready_when` is the payee fact that says it can receive money and `needs_path` where the provider lists what it still needs. `minimum_micros` is the least owed amount sent at once. `return_path` is the page a maker comes back to after the provider's page. Changing any of these is a change here only. Decision source:marketplace-maker-payout-onboarding-and-status-2026-10-04.
